scientific_integrity: The two-step matrix identity follows from explicit Cauchy integrals. Symbolic and numerical checks independently reproduce the coefficients; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only real planar SPD quadratic objectives, exact rank-one directional minimization, and isotropically uniform directions. No noisy finite differences, higher dimensions, or nonlinear objectives are covered. The originality search is not exhaustive.
title: Exact two-step coupling advantage for planar randomized subspace Newton
